tasks.objective: Implement revocable, rotating refresh sessions and wire remember-me on mobile to SecureStore.
side_effects: Additive Prisma migration; do not reset or mutate the development database.
inputs: Approved ADR: 15-minute access token and refresh-token rotation; user selected SecureStore for mobile.
expected_outputs: Atomic single-use refresh rotation, bounded long session, logout/password-change/deactivation revocation, mobile refresh after expiry.
validation: Disposable PostgreSQL integration suite when available
tasks.stop_condition: Rotation and revocation tests pass; no expired or reused refresh token yields an access token.

tasks.objective: Complete generic-response, rate-limited, single-use email password recovery and client reset flow.
side_effects: Additive migration; SendGrid calls mocked in tests; no real email sent.
inputs: Approved ADR: email via SendGrid; hashed short-lived single-use recovery tokens.
expected_outputs: Request and completion endpoints; no account enumeration; secure reset link; all prior sessions revoked.
tasks.stop_condition: Recovery request is enumeration-safe and token use is atomic, expiring, and revokes sessions.

tasks.objective: Build the React/TypeScript backoffice authentication shell with administrator-gated routes and secure browser cookies.
side_effects: Cookie-based browser auth; CORS credential policy; no external deployment or real provider action.
inputs: User selected HttpOnly/Secure browser cookie; shared credentials and admin role are already approved.
expected_outputs: CSRF/Origin-protected browser login, refresh, logout; admin-only protected shell; activation and recovery routes.
tasks.stop_condition: Browser cannot read session tokens; non-admin, revoked, disabled, or CSRF requests are denied.

tasks.objective: Run full relevant suites, inspect all diffs, obtain independent security review, and document remaining runtime proof.
side_effects: No commit, deploy, SendGrid delivery, or production database action.
inputs: Implementation and test evidence from prerequisite tasks.
expected_outputs: Independent review findings resolved or explicitly deferred; docs reflect implemented auth.
validation: Root test, typecheck, format, lint, API build, backoffice build
tasks.stop_condition: No unresolved critical/important findings and all applicable verification results are reported accurately.
